content.summary: A marine researcher buys one citron and carries it from market to rainy pier. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult traveler and one directional route remain continuous. + A selected object is visibly taken from an established stall. + One complete exchange accounts for the object before departure. + A physical foreground wipe bridges rather than resets the route. + The terminal environment preserves traveler, carried object and travel direction.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult marine researcher through a covered harbor market toward a fixed citrus stall. Complete one card payment with the adult vendor while the bag and citron remain readable. Continue into a rain-dark pier lane with the same researcher, bag and travel direction preserved.

invariants.rule: One adult traveler and one directional route remain continuous.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult traveler and one directional route remain continuous."

invariants.rule: A selected object is visibly taken from an established stall.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A selected object is visibly taken from an established stall."

invariants.rule: One complete exchange accounts for the object before departure.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "One complete exchange accounts for the object before departure."

invariants.rule: A physical foreground wipe bridges rather than resets the route.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "A physical foreground wipe bridges rather than resets the route."

invariants.rule: The terminal environment preserves traveler, carried object and travel direction.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal environment preserves traveler, carried object and travel direction."
